description: This PHP file defines the 'HomePage' entity class in an ORM context, representing a mapping to the 'ohrm_home_page' database table. It includes properties like 'id', 'action', 'enableClass', 'priority', and a relation to a 'UserRole' entity, with corresponding getters and setters.

classes.name: HomePage
classes.description: Entity class mapping to the 'ohrm_home_page' database table, representing a configurable home page component with associated user role and display properties.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the home page entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the home page entity.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Retrieves the action associated with this home page entry.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the action associated with this home page entry.

methods.name: getEnableClass
methods.description: Retrieves the CSS class used to enable or style the home page component.

methods.name: setEnableClass
methods.description: Sets the CSS class used to enable or style the home page component.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Gets the priority value indicating the order or importance.
